categories.name: Release A
categories.description: Represents the discharge of an admitted patient under pathway A, contributing positively to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and measured against post-discharge ER returns.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release A (id=17) as observed in the sample variants such as V0008, supporting avoidance of post-discharge deterioration.

categories.name: Release B
categories.description: Represents the discharge of an admitted patient under pathway B, helping to avoid post-discharge deterioration and evaluated against post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release B (id=18) as seen in sample variants like V0068 and V0145, helping avoid post-discharge deterioration.

categories.name: Release C
categories.description: Represents the discharge of an admitted patient under pathway C, contributing to the overall patient disposition goal and measured against post-discharge ER returns.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release C (id=19) as evidenced by sample variant V0710.

categories.name: Release D
categories.description: Represents the discharge of an admitted patient under pathway D, reaching a captured discharge and monitored via post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release D (id=20) as observed in sample variant V0273.

categories.name: Release E
categories.description: Represents the discharge of an admitted patient under pathway E, concluding the patient journey towards a documented disposition.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release E (id=21) based on the goal model decomposition for captured discharges.
